speaker: Doctor
text: I understand you have double vision, difficulty climbing stairs, and upper limb weakness. To better assess your condition, could you tell me if your symptoms worsened during or after exercise, and do you experience any muscle twitching or fatigability?

speaker: Patient
text: The double vision usually happens when I look up or down, and the weakness in my arms and legs gets worse after activity but improves if I rest. I have not noticed balance problems or numbness.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for those details; the pattern of worsening weakness with activity and improvement with rest is very suggestive. Could you describe the nature of your double vision—is it horizontal or vertical, and do you see one eye drifting inward or outward? Also, have you noticed any drooping of your eyelids?
